scanNote:
WORKBOOK 8-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (36-bet). Yuqorida chapda to'q sariq '8' va 'A Brush with Danger'.

CHAP USTUN:
9) 'Join the sentences below using the word(s) in brackets and the past perfect simple.' 1 Ann called for a taxi. She packed her suitcase. (after) 2 Pam and Tom went to the funfair. They finished their homework. (as soon as) 3 We arrived at the harbour. The boat left. (by the time, already) 4 Thomas entered the stadium. The football match started. (when, already) 5 I didn't start reading my book. I did all the washing-up. (until) 6 She went to sleep. Her brother came round to see her. (just, when) 7 The burglar left with the painting. The police arrived. (before) 8 The mechanic fixed the car. The customer returned to the garage. (already, when)
10) 'Read the extracts below and put the verbs in brackets into the past simple, past continuous or past perfect simple.' 1 'Jean and Nick ...... (set off) early that morning. At midday they ...... (travel) on a train heading for Amsterdam, when suddenly, the conductor ...... (announce) that all the passengers had to get off. The train's engine ...... (break down).' 2 'Joanne ...... (lock) all the doors before she ...... (go) to bed. She ...... (walk) up the stairs and ...... (go) straight to her bedroom. She ...... (just/fall) asleep when she ...... (hear) a strange noise. She ...... (get up) and ...... (walk) slowly down the stairs.' 3 'After Lucy and I ...... (find) a nice spot on the beach, we ...... (put on) our swimsuits and ...... (dive) into the water. A few minutes later, we ...... (swim) near the shore, when suddenly, Lucy ...... (start) screaming for help. I ...... (try) to swim to her, but something ...... (grab) her and she ...... (disappear) below the surface, right before my eyes.'

O'NG USTUN:
11) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple, past continuous or past perfect simple.' 1 A: ...... (Mary/already/feed) the baby when you ...... (get) home? B: Yes, and she ...... (also/put) his toys away. 2 A: When ...... (be) the last time you ...... (go out) for dinner? B: Ages ago! It ...... (be) on Jim's birthday, I think. He ...... (take) us to a Chinese restaurant. 3 A: ...... (they/finish) painting the house when you ...... (return)? B: Yes, and they ...... (also/fix) the roof. 4 A: What ...... (happen) to Cathy? B: Well, she ...... (play) in her room and I ...... (cook) dinner, when, suddenly, I ...... (hear) a noise coming from the kitchen. I ...... (run) and ...... (discover) that Cathy ...... (just/put) her china doll in the washing machine. A: Oh, dear! ...... (hurt) herself? B: No, thank goodness, but she was upset because her doll ...... (break) and we had to throw it away! 5 A: ...... (Tom/watch) TV at six o'clock yesterday? B: No, he ...... (play) computer games with his friend, Sean.
• 'Communication: Apologising'.
12) 'Use the words/phrases in the list to complete the dialogues below.' Qiya: 'all right, I'm afraid, Never mind, sorry, I was ill, matter, too busy, worry'. 1 A: ...... I can't help you with the shopping for the party. I haven't finished cleaning the house yet. B: Don't ...... about it. 2 A: I'm so ...... I didn't do the laundry, Mum. I was exhausted. B: Never mind. That's ...... . 3 A: Sorry I didn't take the dog to the vet. I was ...... . B: That's okay. It doesn't ...... . 4 A: I'm so sorry I didn't come to your birthday party. ...... . B: ...... . Are you better now? A: Yes, I'm all right thanks.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '36'.

exercises.explanationUz:
GAPLARNI BIRLAShTIRISh (coursebook
  57-bet 14-mashq).

  ⚠ Qaysi ish OLDIN bo'lganini
  aniqlang → PAST PERFECT.
  Keyingisi → PAST SIMPLE.

  1 avval chamadon, keyin taksi
  2 avval uy vazifasi, keyin
    attraksion
  3 avval qayiq ketdi, keyin biz
    keldik
  4 avval o'yin boshlandi, keyin
    Tomas kirdi
  5 avval idish yuvdim, keyin kitob
  6 avval uxladi, keyin akasi keldi
  7 avval o'g'ri ketdi, keyin
    politsiya
  8 avval mashina tuzatildi, keyin
    mijoz qaytdi


⚠ 'ALREADY' O'RNI:

  had ALREADY left (had va V3
  orasida).


⚠ 'JUST' O'RNI:

  had JUST gone to sleep.


⚠ 'A FUNFAIR':

  = attraksionlar bog'i.


⚠ 'TO COME ROUND':

  = kelmoq (mehmonga).
exercises.exampleEn: After Ann had packed her suitcase, she called for a taxi.
exercises.exampleUz: Ann chamadonini yig'ib bo'lgach, taksi chaqirdi.
modelAnswers: After Ann had packed her suitcase, she called for a taxi.
As soon as Pam and Tom had finished their homework, they went to the funfair.
By the time we arrived at the harbour, the boat had already left.
When Thomas entered the stadium, the football match had already started.
I didn't start reading my book until I had done all the washing-up.
She had just gone to sleep when her brother came round to see her.
The burglar had left with the painting before the police arrived.
The mechanic had already fixed the car when the customer returned to the garage.
modelAnswersUz: Ann chamadonini yig'ib bo'lgach, taksi chaqirdi.
Pam va Tom uy vazifasini tugatishi bilanoq attraksionlar bog'iga borishdi.
Biz bandargohga yetib kelguncha qayiq allaqachon ketgan edi.
Tomas stadionga kirganida futbol o'yini allaqachon boshlangan edi.
Barcha idishlarni yuvib bo'lmagunimcha kitobimni o'qishni boshlamadim.
U endigina uxlab qolgan edi, akasi uni ko'rgani keldi.
Politsiya kelishidan oldin o'g'ri rasm bilan ketib bo'lgan edi.
Mijoz garajga qaytganida mexanik mashinani allaqachon tuzatib bo'lgan edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the extracts below and put the verbs in brackets into the past simple, past continuous or past perfect simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi parchalarni o'qing va qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple, past continuous yoki past perfect simple shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh HIKOYA PARChASI - UCh ZAMON.

  PAST SIMPLE - ketma-ket voqealar:
    set off, announced, locked,
    walked, went, heard, got up,
    put on, dived, started, tried,
    grabbed, disappeared
  PAST CONTINUOUS - fon (when
    suddenly):
    were travelling, were swimming
  PAST PERFECT - oldingi ish:
    had broken down (e'lon
    sababi), had gone (before),
    had just fallen asleep, had
    found (after)


⚠ 1-PARChA: 'The train's engine
  HAD BROKEN DOWN' - e'londan
  OLDIN buzilgan (sabab).


⚠ 2-PARChA: 'locked ... before she
  went' - 'before' dan keyingi ish
  past simple, oldingisi... Bu
  yerda ikkalasi ketma-ket:
  'locked' (simple) before she
  'went' (simple) - yoki 'had
  locked'. Kitob javobi: locked /
  went.


⚠ 'HEADING FOR':

  = ... tomon ketayotgan.


⚠ 'A CONDUCTOR':

  = poyezd nazoratchisi.


⚠ 'A SPOT':

  = joy.


⚠ 'THE SHORE':

  = qirg'oq.


⚠ 'BELOW THE SURFACE':

  = suv yuzasi ostiga.


⚠ 'RIGHT BEFORE MY EYES':

  = ko'z o'ngimda.

items.textEn: Jean and Nick ___ (set off) early that morning.
At midday they ___ (travel) on a train heading for Amsterdam, when suddenly, the conductor ___ (announce) that all the passengers had to get off.
Joanne ___ (lock) all the doors before she ___ (go) to bed.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'before' bilan ketma-ket voqealar → past simple ('had locked' ham qabul qilinadi).

items.textEn: She ___ (walk) up the stairs and ___ (go) straight to her bedroom.
She ___ (just/fall) asleep when she ___ (hear) a strange noise.
She ___ (get up) and ___ (walk) slowly down the stairs.
After Lucy and I ___ (find) a nice spot on the beach, we ___ (put on) our swimsuits and ___ (dive) into the water.
A few minutes later, we ___ (swim) near the shore, when suddenly, Lucy ___ (start) screaming for help.
I ___ (try) to swim to her, but something ___ (grab) her and she ___ (disappear) below the surface, right before my eyes.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Ketma-ket voqealar → past simple (try → tried, grab → grabbed).

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple, past continuous or past perfect simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple, past continuous yoki past perfect simple shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh ZAMON - DIALOGLARDA.

  PAST PERFECT SO'ROQ:
    'Had Mary already fed ...?'
    'Had they finished ...?'
  PAST SIMPLE - aniq vaqt:
    'When was the last time you
    went out?', 'It was on Jim's
    birthday', 'He took us'
  PAST CONTINUOUS - fon:
    'she was playing', 'I was
    cooking', 'he was playing
    computer games at six'


⚠ 'AGES AGO':

  = ancha oldin.


⚠ 'A CHINA DOLL':

  = chinni qo'g'irchoq.


⚠ 'THANK GOODNESS':

  = xudoga shukur.


⚠ 'UPSET':

  = xafa.


⚠ 'TO THROW AWAY':

  = tashlab yubormoq.

lines.speaker: 1 A
lines.uz: Sen uyga kelganingda Meri chaqaloqni allaqachon ovqatlantirib bo'lganmidi?
lines.whyUz: ⚠ Past perfect so'roq: 'Had Mary already fed'; 'got' - past simple.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, and she ___ (also/put) his toys away.
lines.uz: Ha, va o'yinchoqlarini ham yig'ishtirib qo'ygan edi.

lines.speaker: 2 A
lines.en: When ___ (be) the last time you ___ (go out) for dinner?
lines.uz: Oxirgi marta qachon kechki ovqatga chiqding?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Ages ago! It ___ (be) on Jim's birthday, I think. He ___ (take) us to a Chinese restaurant.
lines.uz: Ancha oldin! Jimning tug'ilgan kunida edi shekilli. U bizni xitoy restoraniga olib bordi.

lines.speaker: 3 A
lines.uz: Sen qaytganingda ular uyni bo'yab bo'lganmidi?

lines.speaker: B
lines.uz: Ha, tomni ham tuzatgan edilar.

lines.speaker: 4 A
lines.uz: Ketiga nima bo'ldi?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Well, she ___ (play) in her room and I ___ (cook) dinner, when, suddenly, I ___ (hear) a noise coming from the kitchen. I ___ (run) and ___ (discover) that Cathy ___ (just/put) her china doll in the washing machine.
lines.answer: was playing / was cooking / heard / ran / discovered / had just put
lines.uz: U xonasida o'ynayotgan edi, men kechki ovqat pishirayotgan edim, to'satdan oshxonadan shovqin eshitdim. Yugurib bordim va Keti chinni qo'g'irchog'ini kir yuvish mashinasiga endigina solganini bildim.
lines.whyUz: ⚠ Fon: was playing, was cooking. Voqealar: heard, ran, discovered. Oldingi ish: had just put.

lines.speaker: A
lines.uz: Voy! U o'zini shikastlaganmidi?
lines.whyUz: ⚠ Kashf qilishdan oldin → past perfect so'roq ('Did she hurt' ham mumkin).

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No, thank goodness, but she was upset because her doll ___ (break) and we had to throw it away!
lines.uz: Yo'q, xudoga shukur, lekin qo'g'irchog'i singani uchun xafa bo'ldi va uni tashlab yuborishga to'g'ri keldi!
lines.whyUz: ⚠ Xafa bo'lishdan OLDIN singan → past perfect.

lines.speaker: 5 A
lines.uz: Tom kecha soat oltida televizor ko'rayotgan edimi?
lines.whyUz: ⚠ Aniq vaqtda davom etayotgan ish → past continuous so'roq.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No, he ___ (play) computer games with his friend, Sean.
lines.uz: Yo'q, u do'sti Shon bilan kompyuter o'yini o'ynayotgan edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the words/phrases in the list to complete the dialogues below: all right, I'm afraid, Never mind, sorry, I was ill, matter, too busy, worry.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'z/iboralar bilan quyidagi dialoglarni to'ldiring: all right, I'm afraid, Never mind, sorry, I was ill, matter, too busy, worry.
exercises.explanationUz:
KEChIRIM SO'RASh va JAVOB.

  KEChIRIM:
    I'm afraid I can't ... = afsuski
    I'm so sorry ... = juda
      kechirasiz
    Sorry I didn't ... + SABAB (I was
      too busy / I was ill)
  JAVOB (qabul qilish):
    Don't worry about it. = xavotir
      olmang
    Never mind. That's all right. =
      hechqisi yo'q
    That's okay. It doesn't matter.
      = mayli, farqi yo'q


⚠ 'IT DOESN'T MATTER':

  = ahamiyati yo'q. 'matter' (fe'l)
  = ahamiyatga ega bo'lmoq.


⚠ 'NEVER MIND':

  = hechqisi yo'q, e'tibor bermang.


⚠ 'ARE YOU BETTER NOW?':

  = endi tuzaldingizmi?

lines.speaker: 1 A
lines.en: ___ I can't help you with the shopping for the party. I haven't finished cleaning the house yet.
lines.uz: Afsuski, bazm uchun xaridda yordam berolmayman. Uyni tozalab bo'lmadim hali.

lines.speaker: B
lines.uz: Xavotir olma.

lines.speaker: 2 A
lines.en: I'm so ___ I didn't do the laundry, Mum. I was exhausted.
lines.uz: Kir yuvmaganim uchun juda kechirasiz, oyi. Juda charchagan edim.

lines.speaker: B
lines.uz: Hechqisi yo'q. Mayli.

lines.speaker: 3 A
lines.en: Sorry I didn't take the dog to the vet. I was ___ .
lines.uz: Itni veterinarga olib bormaganim uchun kechirasiz. Juda band edim.

lines.speaker: B
lines.uz: Mayli. Ahamiyati yo'q.

lines.speaker: 4 A
lines.en: I'm so sorry I didn't come to your birthday party. ___ .
lines.uz: Tug'ilgan kuningga kelmaganim uchun juda kechirasan. Kasal edim.
lines.whyUz: ⚠ Sabab: 'I was ill' (keyingi 'Are you better now?').

lines.speaker: B
lines.uz: Hechqisi yo'q. Endi tuzaldingmi?

lines.speaker: A
lines.uz: Ha, yaxshiman, rahmat.

patterns.formula: X had (already/just) + V3 when/before Y + V2.
patterns.exampleEn: The mechanic had already fixed the car when the customer returned.
patterns.exampleUz: Mijoz qaytganida mexanik mashinani allaqachon tuzatib bo'lgan edi.

patterns.formula: X were + V-ing ..., when suddenly, Y + V2.
patterns.exampleEn: We were swimming near the shore, when suddenly, Lucy started screaming.
patterns.exampleUz: Biz qirg'oq yaqinida suzayotgan edik, to'satdan Lyusi qichqira boshladi.

patterns.formula: Had X (already) + V3 when you + V2?
patterns.exampleEn: Had Mary already fed the baby when you got home?
patterns.exampleUz: Sen uyga kelganingda Meri chaqaloqni allaqachon ovqatlantirib bo'lganmidi?

patterns.formula: I'm so sorry I didn't ... + SABAB. - Never mind. / It doesn't matter.
patterns.exampleEn: I'm so sorry I didn't come to your party. I was ill. - Never mind.
patterns.exampleUz: Bazmingga kelmaganim uchun kechirasan. Kasal edim. - Hechqisi yo'q.

groups.ruleUz: ⚠ QO'ShMA OT: fun + fair, washing + machine
